slok.be:
নিরাশীর্যতচিত্তাত্মা ত্যক্তসর্বপরিগ্রহঃ |
শারীরং কেবলং কর্ম কুর্বন্নাপ্নোতি কিল্বিষম্ ||৪-২১||
slok.en:
nirāśīryatacittātmā tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ .
śārīraṃ kevalaṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam ||4-21||
slok.hi:
निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः |
शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् ||४-२१||
slok.ka:
ನಿರಾಶೀರ್ಯತಚಿತ್ತಾತ್ಮಾ ತ್ಯಕ್ತಸರ್ವಪರಿಗ್ರಹಃ |
ಶಾರೀರಂ ಕೇವಲಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಕುರ್ವನ್ನಾಪ್ನೋತಿ ಕಿಲ್ಬಿಷಮ್ ||೪-೨೧||

verse_translation.life_application: Simplify your desires and lifestyle today, taking only what is necessary while performing your duties without greed.

commentary.text: 4.21 Without desire, with mind and self controlled, having abandoned all possessions, performing action by the body alone, he incurs no sin.

slok.be:
রজসি প্রলযং গত্বা কর্মসঙ্গিষু জাযতে |
তথা প্রলীনস্তমসি মূঢযোনিষু জাযতে ||১৪-১৫||
slok.en:
rajasi pralayaṃ gatvā karmasaṅgiṣu jāyate .
tathā pralīnastamasi mūḍhayoniṣu jāyate ||14-15||
slok.hi:
रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते |
तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते ||१४-१५||
slok.ka:
ರಜಸಿ ಪ್ರಲಯಂ ಗತ್ವಾ ಕರ್ಮಸಙ್ಗಿಷು ಜಾಯತೇ |
ತಥಾ ಪ್ರಲೀನಸ್ತಮಸಿ ಮೂಢಯೋನಿಷು ಜಾಯತೇ ||೧೪-೧೫||

verse_translation.life_application: Meeting death in passion, one is born among those attached to action; dying in ignorance, born in dull wombs.

commentary.text: 14.15 Meeting death when Rajas (mode of passion) is predominant, he takes birth among people attached to action; and dying when Tamas (mode of ignorance) is predominant, he takes birth in the wombs of the senseless (animal kingdom etc.).

slok.be:
তমেব শরণং গচ্ছ সর্বভাবেন ভারত |
তত্প্রসাদাত্পরাং শান্তিং স্থানং প্রাপ্স্যসি শাশ্বতম্ ||১৮-৬২||
slok.en:
tameva śaraṇaṃ gaccha sarvabhāvena bhārata .
tatprasādātparāṃ śāntiṃ sthānaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam ||18-62||
slok.hi:
तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत |
तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम् ||१८-६२||
slok.ka:
ತಮೇವ ಶರಣಂ ಗಚ್ಛ ಸರ್ವಭಾವೇನ ಭಾರತ |
ತತ್ಪ್ರಸಾದಾತ್ಪರಾಂ ಶಾನ್ತಿಂ ಸ್ಥಾನಂ ಪ್ರಾಪ್ಸ್ಯಸಿ ಶಾಶ್ವತಮ್ ||೧೮-೬೨||

verse_translation.life_application: Take refuge in God alone with all your heart; by divine grace you will attain supreme peace and eternal abode.

commentary.text: 18.62 Surrender unto Him alone with all your heart, O Bharata. By His grace you shall attain supreme peace and the eternal abode.

slok.be:
অনেকবাহূদরবক্ত্রনেত্রং
পশ্যামি ত্বাং সর্বতোঽনন্তরূপম্ |
নান্তং ন মধ্যং ন পুনস্তবাদিং
পশ্যামি বিশ্বেশ্বর বিশ্বরূপ ||১১-১৬||
slok.en:
anekabāhūdaravaktranetraṃ paśyāmi tvāṃ sarvato.anantarūpam .
nāntaṃ na madhyaṃ na punastavādiṃ paśyāmi viśveśvara viśvarūpa ||11-16||
slok.hi:
अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं
पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम् |
नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं
पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप ||११-१६||
slok.ka:
ಅನೇಕಬಾಹೂದರವಕ್ತ್ರನೇತ್ರಂ
ಪಶ್ಯಾಮಿ ತ್ವಾಂ ಸರ್ವತೋಽನನ್ತರೂಪಮ್ |
ನಾನ್ತಂ ನ ಮಧ್ಯಂ ನ ಪುನಸ್ತವಾದಿಂ
ಪಶ್ಯಾಮಿ ವಿಶ್ವೇಶ್ವರ ವಿಶ್ವರೂಪ ||೧೧-೧೬||

verse_translation.life_application: See infinite arms, stomachs, mouths, and eyes on all sides, with neither beginning, middle, nor end.

commentary.text: 11.16 O Lord of the universe, I see You with many arms, bellies, mouths, and eyes, and of infinite forms on all sides. O Cosmic Form, I see neither Your end, nor middle, nor beginning.

slok.be:
অহংকারং বলং দর্পং কামং ক্রোধং পরিগ্রহম্ |
বিমুচ্য নির্মমঃ শান্তো ব্রহ্মভূযায কল্পতে ||১৮-৫৩||
slok.en:
ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham .
vimucya nirmamaḥ śānto brahmabhūyāya kalpate ||18-53||
slok.hi:
अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् |
विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ||१८-५३||
slok.ka:
ಅಹಂಕಾರಂ ಬಲಂ ದರ್ಪಂ ಕಾಮಂ ಕ್ರೋಧಂ ಪರಿಗ್ರಹಮ್ |
ವಿಮುಚ್ಯ ನಿರ್ಮಮಃ ಶಾನ್ತೋ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಭೂಯಾಯ ಕಲ್ಪತೇ ||೧೮-೫೩||

verse_translation.life_application: Free from egoism, power, pride, lust, anger, possessiveness, tranquil in mind—he is fit for becoming one with Brahman.

commentary.text: 18.53 Having abandoned egoism, strength, arrogance, desire, anger, and possessiveness, and being free from the notion of 'mine' and peaceful, he is fit for attaining Brahman.

slok.be:
প্রকৃত্যৈব চ কর্মাণি ক্রিযমাণানি সর্বশঃ |
যঃ পশ্যতি তথাত্মানমকর্তারং স পশ্যতি ||১৩-৩০||
slok.en:
prakṛtyaiva ca karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni sarvaśaḥ .
yaḥ paśyati tathātmānamakartāraṃ sa paśyati ||13-30||
slok.hi:
प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः |
यः पश्यति तथात्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति ||१३-३०||
slok.ka:
ಪ್ರಕೃತ್ಯೈವ ಚ ಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಕ್ರಿಯಮಾಣಾನಿ ಸರ್ವಶಃ |
ಯಃ ಪಶ್ಯತಿ ತಥಾತ್ಮಾನಮಕರ್ತಾರಂ ಸ ಪಶ್ಯತಿ ||೧೩-೩೦||

verse_translation.life_application: When one sees the diversity of beings resting in the One and spreading out from That alone, he attains Brahman.

commentary.text: 13.30 He who sees that all actions are performed in every way by Nature alone, and that the Self is actionless, he indeed sees.

slok.be:
যা নিশা সর্বভূতানাং তস্যাং জাগর্তি সংযমী |
যস্যাং জাগ্রতি ভূতানি সা নিশা পশ্যতো মুনেঃ ||২-৬৯||
slok.en:
yā niśā sarvabhūtānāṃ tasyāṃ jāgarti saṃyamī .
yasyāṃ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśā paśyato muneḥ ||2-69||
slok.hi:
या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी |
यस्यां जाग्रति भूतानि सा निशा पश्यतो मुनेः ||२-६९||
slok.ka:
ಯಾ ನಿಶಾ ಸರ್ವಭೂತಾನಾಂ ತಸ್ಯಾಂ ಜಾಗರ್ತಿ ಸಂಯಮೀ |
ಯಸ್ಯಾಂ ಜಾಗ್ರತಿ ಭೂತಾನಿ ಸಾ ನಿಶಾ ಪಶ್ಯತೋ ಮುನೇಃ ||೨-೬೯||

verse_translation.life_application: Stay mindful of inner spiritual values even when surrounding culture remains focused purely on material pursuits.

commentary.text: 2.69 That which is night for all beings, in that the self-controlled person remains awake; and that in which all beings are awake, that is night for the sage who sees (the Reality).

slok.be:
গাণ্ডীবং স্রংসতে হস্তাত্ত্বক্চৈব পরিদহ্যতে |
ন চ শক্নোম্যবস্থাতুং ভ্রমতীব চ মে মনঃ ||১-৩০||
slok.en:
gāṇḍīvaṃ sraṃsate hastāttvakcaiva paridahyate .
na ca śaknomyavasthātuṃ bhramatīva ca me manaḥ ||1-30||
slok.hi:
गाण्डीवं स्रंसते हस्तात्त्वक्चैव परिदह्यते |
न च शक्नोम्यवस्थातुं भ्रमतीव च मे मनः ||१-३०||
slok.ka:
ಗಾಣ್ಡೀವಂ ಸ್ರಂಸತೇ ಹಸ್ತಾತ್ತ್ವಕ್ಚೈವ ಪರಿದಹ್ಯತೇ |
ನ ಚ ಶಕ್ನೋಮ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾತುಂ ಭ್ರಮತೀವ ಚ ಮೇ ಮನಃ ||೧-೩೦||

verse_translation.life_application: Give yourself permission to pause when emotional turmoil threatens to sweep away your self-control.

commentary.text: 1.30 The Gandiva bow is slipping from my hand and my skin is burning. My mind seems to be reeling, and I am unable to stand still.

slok.be:
কস্মাচ্চ তে ন নমেরন্মহাত্মন্
গরীযসে ব্রহ্মণোঽপ্যাদিকর্ত্রে |
অনন্ত দেবেশ জগন্নিবাস
ত্বমক্ষরং সদসত্তত্পরং যত্ ||১১-৩৭||
slok.en:
kasmācca te na nameranmahātman garīyase brahmaṇo.apyādikartre .
ananta deveśa jagannivāsa tvamakṣaraṃ sadasattatparaṃ yat ||11-37||
slok.hi:
कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन्
गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे |
अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास
त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत् ||११-३७||
slok.ka:
ಕಸ್ಮಾಚ್ಚ ತೇ ನ ನಮೇರನ್ಮಹಾತ್ಮನ್
ಗರೀಯಸೇ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣೋಽಪ್ಯಾದಿಕರ್ತ್ರೇ |
ಅನನ್ತ ದೇವೇಶ ಜಗನ್ನಿವಾಸ
ತ್ವಮಕ್ಷರಂ ಸದಸತ್ತತ್ಪರಂ ಯತ್ ||೧೧-೩೭||

verse_translation.life_application: Worship God as the primal creator, greater than all, infinite Lord of celestial beings, abode of the universe.

commentary.text: 11.37 O great Soul! Why should they not bow down to You, who are the primal creator of even Brahma and the greatest of all? (Because) O Infinite Lord! O God of gods! O Abode of the universe! You are that imperishable reality (Akshara) which is existence, non-existence, and that which is beyond both.

verse_translation.life_application: Endure temporary discomforts like heat, cold, praise, or criticism today without letting them disrupt your inner balance.

commentary.text: 2.14 O son of Kunti, the union of the senses and their objects, which gives cold, heat, pleasure and pain, has a beginning and an end; they are impermanent, therefore, O Bharata, endure them.
